players.note: He didn't get there in Week 6, but the target volume has been excellent the past two weeks.
AJ Brown has about a billion drops in Week 6, but the more important number was 10 targets. Also, with Romeo Doubs banged up, he may be relied on more heavily. Don't panic about one bad game.
Already been through his bye week, in a pass-happy offense that is heavily consolidated between him and Ja'Marr Chase. Higgins has top 12 upside on any given week
13 targets in Week 6? Yup, Coker is back. I'd prefer him to Tet at cost.
The target volume is spread out more than we'd like, but Burden is technically the top target option in a Caleb Williams-led offense. That's enough for me.

Evans could 
miss extended time with Achilles soreness. Given his age and lengthy injury history, I'd rather sell now.
Hand up, I was wrong on this one. Bo Nix is such a terrible passer that Jaylen Waddle is quickly becoming irrelevant for fantasy. Sell "low" if you want; I have lost all hope for this offense.

Back-to-back mediocre games for Michael Wilson since Marvin Harrison Jr. left. Was MHJ truly opening things up for Wilson? Possibly. I'm holding for another nuclear performance from Mike before shopping him.

Carnell Tate is so far and away the best player on the Titans, it's not even funny. If they want to build on the momentum of the Week 6 win, they'll need to force-feed Tate the same way Rutgers force-feeds KJ Duff.
Brutal Week 6 performance from Denzel Boston, with one catch for 15 yards. This was a defensive battle through and through. Now is not the time to sell low.

DK Metcalf is your perennial underperformer relative to expected fantasy points. Finally, we had a good game in Week 6, but it felt like it could've been much better. At least the target volume has been elite this season. I'm holding and continuing to plug into my lineup.

Josh Downs' season has been as frustrating as any fantasy player in 2026 for me. You're not getting any reasonable return right now, so may as well hold. Hopefully Indy can figure things out soon; Downs is still technically the WR1.

The Germ is loose! Germie Bernard had his breakout in Week 6, and he's here to stay. His low aDOT role is perfect for Aaron Rodgers' late-career playstyle. With Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR, it's all DK and Germie.
Third pass-catching offense on the Bears. There's not enough target volume going his way to trust him as a starter. Name value may still get you a decent FLEX player in return.
10-target game for Meyers? Sell now. He's far too volatile an asset to trust in your lineups.
Out for 6-10 weeks with an apparent knee injury. Absolutely brutal turn of events, and possibly the mark of the end of his career.
